posts.title: Frendigo App
posts.excerpt: iOS, Android, and web transportation marketplace — cheap rides, great vibes.
posts.content: Multi-platform Frendigo app for riders and drivers: commute planner, provider marketplace with transparent estimates, mid-trip maps, itemized fares, and direct pay. Built as a Flutter mobile app with Angular web, Firebase, and Google Maps — subscription pricing from MPG, USDOT, and EIA gas data instead of per-trip commissions.
posts.features:
• Client commute planner and marketplace

  • Provider rates, vehicles, and add-ons

  • Live maps and trip tracking

  • Itemized summaries and direct pay

  • iOS TestFlight and Android beta

posts.title: W2 OCONUS Selector
posts.excerpt: Combatant-command selector for Warfighter Wellness visitors stationed OCONUS.
posts.content: A homepage modal and footer flow on warfighterwellness.org that asks visitors to select a combatant command (AFRICOM, CENTCOM, EUCOM, INDOPACOM, NORTHCOM, SOUTHCOM). posts.features:
• Select-a-command modal

  • OCONUS footer banner with command-specific contacts
